walk:
induction n generalizing a b with
  | zero => simp [walk]
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [walk]
    have h := ih (a+2) (b+1)
    constructor <;> omega
reverse:
have h : ∀ (xs ys : List Nat), revAcc xs ys = xs.reverse ++ ys := by
    intro xs
    induction xs with
    | nil => intro ys; rfl
    | cons x xs ih =>
      intro ys
      simp [revAcc, ih, List.reverse_cons, List.append_assoc]
  simp [h]
tree:
have h : ∀ (t : Tree) (acc : List Nat), treeAcc t acc = flatten t ++ acc := by
    intro t
    induction t with
    | leaf x => intro acc; rfl
    | fork l r ihl ihr =>
      intro acc
      simp [treeAcc, ihl, ihr, flatten, List.append_assoc]
  have h2 : ∀ t, flatten (mirror t) = (flatten t).reverse := by
    intro t
    induction t with
    | leaf x => rfl
    | fork l r ihl ihr =>
      simp [mirror, flatten, ihl, ihr, List.reverse_append]
  simp [h, h2]
split:
induction xs using splitPairs.induct with
  | case1 => rfl
  | case2 x => rfl
  | case3 x y xs ih => simp [splitPairs, weave, ih]
